name: Melilot
message: 「Preparations for the Holy Night Festival seem to be going smoothly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone is working hard, so I think we're fine for now.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yep, yep! Make sure you pull your weight too!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sebastian, I don't know how to read this layout map.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the tasks assigned to my lady to me, Riesling Tooyama.」
It seems some committee members are relying entirely on others, but oh well.

name: Misa
message: 「Everything's perfect on our end too. How's it going over there?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd say all that's left is the final inspection.」
The other tasks seem to be going smoothly for the most part as well.

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh? Big brother, what are you guys doing? What about special training?」

name: Synn
message: 「We're getting ready for the Holy Night Festival. Today's our once-a-year festival, after all.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Oh, I get it! That's why there are so many sparkly decorations up today!」

name: Sally
message: 「Does that mean we get to eat tons of yummy food too!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Food stalls are being set up, and they're planning to serve Christmas cake too\s07」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, getting excited is fine and all, but don't forget we have a huge job waiting for us before that」

name: Melilot
message: 「We must not overlook Soltia and Azel's movements」

name: Melilot
message: 「According to observation data, Re-Crea's energy will reach its peak tonight」

name: Melilot
message: 「They will undoubtedly make their move then」

name: Synn
message: 「So things will be settled by the end of today...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So it's finally time for the decisive battle」

name: Macaron
message: 「A decisive battle! Gwaaah, I'm getting all fired up!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Shall I put in some eye drops?」

name: Sally
message: 「Guess tasty treats are on hold until then~」

name: Ria
message: 「I feel like there's a weird lack of tension here, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be fine. I'm sure we can pull it off」

name: Melilot
message: 「We know better than anyone just how diligently all of you have completed your special training」

name: Helena
message: 「Don't worry, we'll get through Re-Crea without a hitch\s07」

name: Melilot
message: 「Let's enjoy the Holy Night Festival at our leisure afterward」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well then, shall we all get pumped up and head to our posts」

name: Melilot
message: 「In that case, let us tighten security around Finis Tower as well」

name: Melilot
message: 「Finis Tower sits on the border of the Three Realms, making it the most spatially unstable location」

name: Helena
message: 「Meaning it's the prime spot to trigger Re-Crea and collapse the world」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's safe to say there is a very high chance that Azel and his group will appear」

name: Nanaka
message: 「To think the main venue of the Holy Night Festival would be the biggest danger zone...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Of course, we also need to pay attention to other areas」

name: Melilot
message: 「Therefore, I will take charge of security around the tower」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then the two of us will guard the venue grounds around Finis Tower」

name: Helena
message: 「I'll leave patrolling inside the academy to the rest of you」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi, so it's a contest to see who can catch more suspicious characters!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sebastian, have all preparations been made without oversight?」

name: Riesling
message: 「The surveillance cameras are completely ready, my lady」

name: Melilot
message: 「For the time being, it looks like we'll manage somehow」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I believe he's the type of person who never breaks a promise」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, if Synn-chan says so, I suppose I'll keep my hopes up」

name: Synn
message: 「...It's gotten a bit chilly, hasn't it」

name: Melilot
message: 「I am fine. What about you, Sakura-kun--aren't you cold?」

name: Synn
message: 「Just having you by my side, Melilot-san, kind of raises my body temperature」

name: Melilot
message: 「Geez, you have terrible taste, as always...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well, I suppose I'm in no position to talk either...\s03」
Somehow, it feels peaceful and just like any other day.
It's hard to believe the end of the world is right around the corner.

name: Synn
message: 「...If only nothing would happen, just like this...」

name: Melilot
message: 「After all, driving back Re-Crea is my sole reason for existing...」

name: Synn
message: 「Please don't talk as if you only live for Re-Crea」

name: Synn
message: 「I think you're properly living your own life, one that you chose for yourself, Melilot-san」

name: Synn
message: 「At least, from the time I've spent with you up until now, that's how I feel」

name: Synn
message: 「Please don't say something so lonely as that you only live for your mission...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...I'm sorry, that was thoughtless of me」

name: Synn
message: 「I want you to smile more, Melilot--out of happiness, fun, and all sorts of things...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes... your feelings are getting through to me... clearly, Sakura-kun」

name: Melilot
message: 「I've always wanted... to do that too...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because if I'm with you, Sakura-kun, that wish can come true...」

name: Synn
message: 「So that I can keep living alongside you, Melilot」

name: Synn
message: 「So, I want you to as well...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Rather than fighting out of a sense of duty...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I want to stay with you forever, Sakura-kun--」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'll fight to make that wish come true」
Those were the words that had once guided me.
We trust each other, and rely on one another....
That's why the two of us can walk forward together.

name: Melilot
message: 「...Somehow, I feel like a weight has been lifted off my shoulders」

name: Synn
message: 「Even you were nervous after all, Melilot...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「If anything, I suppose I was anxious...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I've always been anxious about what lies ahead for me」

name: Melilot
message: 「I don't want future generations to walk the arduous path of the Nibe's duty...」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, there's no guarantee whatsoever that Re-Crea will end in my generation...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Nor had I found the resolve to endure all that hardship on my own」

name: Melilot
message: 「Someone precious who will walk beside me...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun. Meeting you allowed me to change」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because I never once imagined fulfilling this duty by working together with someone else...」

name: Synn
message: 「...We aren't just walking together until Re-Crea」

name: Synn
message: 「We'll keep walking together forever after that, too」
Gently and hesitantly, we link our outstretched pinky fingers together.

name: Synn
message: 「Doing something like this... is a little embarrassing, isn't it...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It would have felt natural if you hadn't pointed it out...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well, I don't mind. It's very much like you, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「And forgiving me like that is very much like you too, Melilot-san--I like that about you」
Still, I find myself thinking that moments like this are nice, too.
A steady shockwave of power that shakes the very core of the body.

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes... Did he turn our expectations against us and shift his position...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Certainly, with enough power to easily brush aside Bylous, it can be activated even without being directly beneath the tower...」

name: Synn
message: 「The power... is getting stronger and stronger!」

name: Soltia
message: 「I can't have you underestimating me when I'm serious」

name: Soltia
message: 「I haven't lived as a high-ranking Demon governing both Spirit Power and magic for nothing」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, luring us here won't accomplish anything」
Bands of light surging up from beneath her feet entangle Melilot-san's body!

name: Soltia
message: 「It's a binding barrier. I hope it's to your liking?」

name: Melilot
message: 「How could I... let my guard down...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Even the noble Nive Clan is no better than a newborn babe like this...」

name: Soltia
message: 「The Demon Lord can still move, can he...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Born into the Nive Clan, possessing high spiritual quality despite being a Demon...」

name: Soltia
message: 「And yet, you made no effort to grow closer to the angels, devoting yourself solely to a pointless mission!」

name: Soltia
message: 「Do you have any idea how much I coveted that bloodline...」

name: Soltia
message: 「How much I cursed my own bloodline!」

name: Soltia
message: 「The world will be purified by Re-Crea, and I shall be reborn as an angel!」

name: Synn
message: 「Like hell... I'd let you do that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacrificing everyone's happiness just for your own sake...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll never, ever let you do that!」

name: Soltia
message: 「You can't do a single thing on your own... so please stop talking so big」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if I'm not strong enough on my own...」

name: Synn
message: 「We have comrades who trust each other!」

name: Soltia
message: 「Do you really think I infiltrated the academy without a plan?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Caught in the barrier I've stretched all across the academy, completely unable to move」

name: Melilot
message: 「To think you'd calculated even that far...」

name: Soltia
message: 「I told you, didn't I? That I was serious...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Right about now at the tower, Azel should be refining the energy of Re-Crea」

name: Soltia
message: 「You lot can stay right there, drowned in despair, and bear witness to the end of the world!」

name: Soltia
message: 「Soon, the world will be reborn into the form it was meant to take!」
The bands of light shatter to pieces!

name: Lolotte
message: 「We've arrived to rescue you, yes we have!」

name: Bylous
message: 「...Leaving such an eyesore of a magic circle alone simply rubbed me the wrong way」

name: Bylous
message: 「Just something I did along the way. Pay it no mind」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And just like that, he saved us out of nowhere」

name: Bylous
message: 「Don't let something of this level hold you back, Demon Lord」

name: Bylous
message: 「Did you really think a barrier of that level would hold me back?」

name: Soltia
message: 「...To think you would lend a hand to the likes of them.」

name: Bylous
message: 「You stood in the path I chose to walk. That is all.」

name: Soltia
message: 「However, no matter what you do, it's already too late.」

name: Soltia
message: 「After all, Azel is about to activate Re-Crea at Finis Tower!」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, we can still make it in time!」

name: Synn
message: 「If we head out to stop Azel right now!」

name: Soltia
message: 「And you think I'm going to allow that?」

name: Bylous
message: 「In seeking the light too much, it seems your eyes have grown terribly clouded.」

name: Misa
message: 「If you mess this up, I won't forgive you, got it!」

name: Bylous
message: 「We'll soon see whether it's pointless or not.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Either way, the only difference is whether you vanish sooner or later!」

name: Soltia
message: 「Writhe in despair and grovel before the power of Re-Crea!!」
